name: mcp-stdio-purity
description: Fail CI when an MCP stdio server writes any non-JSON-RPC record to stdout during startup, probing, or cleanup.
targetUsers: Maintainers who release stdio MCP servers and need client-independent transport compatibility checks in local development and CI.
jobToBeDone: Run a real MCP server command from initialize through cleanup and fail deterministically if stdout contains anything other than JSON-RPC 2.0 records.
distributionPath: Checksum-verified reproducible Linux and macOS archives, go install, and a source-built composite GitHub Action pinned by full commit SHA.
successMetric: Within 30 days, one unrelated external MCP server repository uses the checker to catch real stdout contamination before release and shows the producer-side fix.

demandEvidence.independenceKey: CAMEL MCP server stdout logging failure
Codex app-server stdio stream parsing context
Lokka MCP server stdout contamination context

alternatives.name: MCP Inspector 1.0.0 CLI
alternatives.gap: Returned tools/list successfully for clean, startup, late, and cleanup contamination fixtures without turning the extra raw stdout records into a failing exit status.

alternatives.name: mcp-compliance 0.16.3 strict transport and lifecycle suite
alternatives.gap: Passed the focused strict suite for clean and all three contaminated streams because valid protocol responses remained available.

alternatives.name: mcp-z 1.0.5 health inspection
alternatives.gap: Reported successful health for clean and all three contamination modes without enforcing an all-record stdout purity postcondition.

alternatives.name: MCP 2025-11-25 stdio specification and manual raw probe
alternatives.gap: Defines the stdout contract and enables manual diagnosis but does not provide a content-safe bounded CI exit contract for an arbitrary real server command.

duplicateSearch.summary: Installed three exact alternative versions and ran the same clean, startup, late, and cleanup fixtures; none enforced the bounded all-record purity distinction.

differentiation: A shell-free, content-safe preflight that owns raw stdout through bounded descendant cleanup and fails on every non-JSON-RPC record without emulating a full MCP client.
commitMessage: fix: pin Action example to immutable release revision
